title: kbgit.py contribute holds back only roots that say visibility: internal while publish refuses every root that does not say public
goal: kg_contrib.internal_dirs holds back every root and pointer that does not say visibility: public (a restricted value or a missing line too) and reads a _root.md under _tools/fixtures as no root, as publish's tree refusal does, and its docstring and the git.md contribute paragraph state that a root or pointer not saying visibility: public is private

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/kg_contrib.py').read();sys.exit('contribute holds back only visibility == internal' if chr(61)*2+' '+chr(34)+'internal'+chr(34) in t else 0)

repro_reason: internal_dirs needs a scratch repository with a contribute upstream; the comparison it makes is the literal == internal test in its source

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbpublic as p,kg_contrib as c;p.tree_files=lambda rev,cwd:["kb/t1/_root.md","kb/_roots/t2.md","kb/t3/_root.md","_tools/fixtures/lang/de/_root.md"];p.texts=lambda specs,cwd:{s:("---
